name: War on the Woodpaw
summary: At Camp Mojache, Hadoken Swiftstrider asks you to thin the Woodpaw gnolls’ growing numbers. Their attacks have grown more fevered, and ten Woodpaw Gnoll Manes will answer his call.

sections.title: A Threat to the Camp
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider says the camp’s survival matters more than the gnolls’ claim to Feralas. Unless Camp Mojache stands firm, he warns, the gnolls may drive it from the whole region. Their attacks have grown more fevered, so he wants their numbers thinned. For ten Woodpaw gnoll manes, he offers generous pay.

sections.title: Hadoken's Response
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider calls the manes a good start. He has made the same request of others who have fought the gnolls before, and their efforts once held them back. Lately, the gnolls have pushed north into the area Camp Mojache holds sway over far more often. Their attacks have turned savage, almost desperate. Hadoken says he has a plan that might settle the matter.

faq.q: Who offers this bounty in Feralas?
aliases: who gives war on the woodpaw
where to turn in war on the woodpaw
quest giver war on the woodpaw
faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider offers the bounty at Camp Mojache.

faq.q: Why is Camp Mojache targeting the Woodpaw gnolls?
faq.answer: Hadoken regards the Woodpaw gnolls as a constant danger to Camp Mojache. Their attacks have grown more fevered, and he fears the camp will be driven from the whole region unless it stands firm.

faq.q: What proof does Hadoken Swiftstrider require?
aliases: what items needed war on the woodpaw
faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider requires ten Woodpaw Gnoll Manes.
